meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动匹配网文写作工具，管理创作习惯
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常写网络小说，想要一个统管写作工具和习惯的入口。
copy.tagline_en: Auto-route your web novel writing tools and manage your habits.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write web novels and want a central hub for your writing tools and habits.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会成为一个网文工具箱的入口:先判断你想干什么,再把任务分发给对应的写作、拆文、扫榜、审稿等子工具;还能记住你的写作习惯、启动本地工作台、检查更新。
howto.when: 当你用“/story”等命令,或说出“我想写小说”“记住我的写作习惯”等意图时触发;请求不明确时,它会先问你要写长篇还是短篇。

say.text: 我想写小说,帮我开个长篇的坑
say.note: 它会判断意图,把任务交给写长篇的子工具

say.text: 记住我的写作习惯:我习惯每章 3000 字
say.note: 它会把你的原话存入作者记忆
它会在本地启动 Dashboard 并发你访问地址

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the entry point of a web-novel toolbox: it infers what you want, routes the task to sub-skills for writing, analysis, ranking, review, etc., and can manage author habits, launch a local dashboard, or check for updates.
howto.when_en: Triggers on commands like "/story" or when you say things like "I want to write a novel" or "remember my writing habits". If the request is unclear it asks whether you want a long or short story.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel, help me start a long one
say_en.note: It will route the task to the long-form writing sub-skill.

say_en.text: Remember my habit: I write about 3000 words per chapter
say_en.note: It will save your original words into author memory.
It starts the local Dashboard and sends you the URL.
